name: dg-autonomy
description: Safe goal-to-gate engineering autonomy for Dynasty Genius

interface.shortDescription: Take engineering goals safely to a human gate.
interface.longDescription: Plans, implements, tests, performs real-surface QA, and reviews authorized Dynasty Genius engineering work without crossing publication or permission gates.
defaultPrompt: Use dg-auto to take this goal to a human gate.
Use dg-plan to write a test-first implementation plan.
Use dg-review to verify this worktree and its evidence.
